body.name: Scope for compliance framework established
body.description: The boundary of the framework is defined.
body.detail: Scope is declared explicitly and every control is attributed to an owner inside or outside it.
observations: In scope: the TRACE-X application, its two datastores, and the evidence lifecycle from ingest to certified export.
Out of scope: the agency's corporate estate — email, endpoints, network, premises and HR. Those controls are listed and marked, never silently dropped, so the boundary itself is auditable.
